industryLifecycle.holdingHealth: Known feature-valid industry with relative60>0 and breadth60>0.5. Current relative20 and participation remain observed/ranked but are not required for holding health.
industryLifecycle.failureCount: Advance on every known feature-valid health-false close, reset on health-true. Unknown interrupts/reset count without a negative vote.
industryLifecycle.retirement: Three consecutive known health-false closes deactivate the industry and trigger the common industry-risk sell for any holding currently known to belong to it, including entry-admission controls.
industryLifecycle.admission: Active, feature-valid and currently health-true industry; choose at most3 by the unchanged V1 composite percentile score, sector-code tie break. Rising stock prices or daily rank changes do not force portfolio sales.
industryLifecycle.unknown: Retain past activation memory during unknown observations but prohibit new entries on unknown current health; do not infer retirement.
industryLifecycle.snapshotChange: Reset all activation/failure state and dated leader relations at each newly available publication snapshot. An old-held stock with unknown new industry retains its individual risk protection without invented sector-risk votes.
industryLifecycle.noExpiryTuning: No fixed active-day expiry or newly scanned threshold; activation and retirement derive from pre-existing strength and longer-trend/breadth definitions.
